tps.strataDecodeTitle: Live sliding-window decode rate. When that window is unavailable, the active-slot mean sums each active slot’s generated tokens divided by its elapsed time since first token; it excludes prefill time.
tps.completedDecodeTitle: Completed-request decode rate; held between completions, not the speed of a currently running stream.
tps.perStreamTitle: Average decode throughput of one running stream (1 / mean seconds per output token). Only engines that publish a per-token latency histogram report it.
tps.strataPrefillTitle: Engine-reported mean for computed/new prompt tokens. It may be from an earlier prefill and is not an aggregate across slots.
tps.prefillingStrataTitle: A prompt is being processed; no current prefill rate is available.
tps.prefillingTitle: A prompt is being processed. The engine reports its speed only when the request finishes.
tps.noPrefillTitle: No current prefill measurement; zero is not evidence of no prefill.
tps.effectiveTitle: Completion-window tokens divided by prefill seconds; not continuous live throughput.
